text: Kashkaval curd is cheddared until plastic, then sliced and scalded in hot salted water rather than plain water, kneaded and moulded into wheels; the brine scald salts the paste as it is stretched.

steps.note: The curd is scalded in hot brine of 5–6 % salt, which salts it as it is stretched.

steps.note: The cheese is moulded into wheels.
